thread:
tara (docs): FYI — we're shipping a docs restructure to consolidate language quickstarts into a new 'Recipes' section and deprecate the legacy example/quickstart pages. This also surfaces a small SDK compatibility note: an input field will be renamed in the public payload. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1448 

leo (eng): quick summary of the SDK impact (short): the server-side routing now expects `model_id` instead of `model` in the request body for multi-model routing. It's a one-line change for most clients but it is technically breaking for callers that used freeform `model` fields.

mira (devex): I'll take the migration guide. Plan: add a top-level 'Recipes migration' doc with examples for JS/Python/Go + a convenience script to rewrite old examples. I'll open a PR today.

sam (product): timeline? We need this communicated to Dedicated customers and highlighted in the release notes. Is this going out with the docs deploy tomorrow?

tara (docs): Target: docs deploy + preview tomorrow AM (canary) and full flip Friday. Migration deprecation window: 60 days after flip. We'll include a banner and changelog entry. @sam will you coordinate the Dedicated customer emails? :handshake:

francesca (support): Noted. I'll update the support playbook and add a canned response for customers who hit 400s because of the field name. Also flagging top accounts that might have automation.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/1448 (:rocket:)

leo (eng): Small SDK code example for quick copy/paste — old vs new: 
```js
// OLD
await client.request({ model: "redwood-7b", input: "Hello" })
// NEW
await client.request({ model_id: "redwood-7b", input: "Hello" })
```

mira (devex): I'll add a redirect map so old quickstart URLs still land on the new recipes pages for 60 days. Also adding a small CLI script in the docs repo to rewrite `model` to `model_id` for local test suites.

leo (eng): Also adding a single E2E to the SDK CI that validates both `model` (compat shim) and `model_id` to avoid breakages during rollout. I'll PR to the SDKs today.

ops-bot: Canary docs flip scheduled: 2026-06-12 09:30 UTC (window 30m).

tara (docs): Call to action list: 1) @mira publish migration guide PR (assigned) 2) @leo update SDKs + CI checks 3) @francesca update support playbook + top-account check 4) @sam coordinate Dedicated/customer comms. Please review PR #1448 and leave :eyes: or approve by EOD Thursday.

sam (product): Ack — I'll draft the Dedicated customer note and post here for review.

francesca (support): Thanks — will include troubleshooting snippet and a KB article link once the migration guide lands.

tara (docs): Thanks team. Keeping this thread for status updates — ping me here for anything blocking. :rocket:
